title: Authored Dropdown single-open Save/reload/Publish lifecycle
summary: The existing native details-name behavior was already implemented, but the Dropdown singleOpen control lacked a real-browser lifecycle assertion. The browser regression now verifies its accessible Inspector control, same-name native details group, immediate Canvas exclusivity, draft-only Save behavior, Editor reload restoration, separate Publish, keyboard toggling, responsive public rendering, and independence from the Accordion details group.

chromium.scope: full existing authored-content Chromium lifecycle scenario with Dropdown single-open added
